rationale: The only implementation delta is the condition used before expanding headroom: the vulnerable version tests skb_headroom(skb), while the fixed version tests whether skb_mac_header(skb) has at least fragment-header-sized space before skb->head. The Logic section states only that headers are adjusted and a fragment header is inserted; it does not specify either headroom condition, its absence, or any mitigation-specific behavior. Its remaining claims apply to both versions.
